searchText: For payload attestations, is it enough if PTC validators set `blob_data_available=true` if they have all their assigned custody columns for that block, without checking if all of the blobs are actually available? yes, that's the expected behavior https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4769 probably worth clarifying it in the spec then we were thinking it could either be renamed to `columns_data_available` or removed entirely. It can't be removed, the proposer for the next block needs to use this information if it's not a super node Also I would like to keep the `blob_data_available` name. The blob data is what's important. But I agree the naming is a bit unintuitive. happy to update the PR to the name folks agree upon 🙏 trustless bids with <60% participation
